label: RayWn2App HTTPS API v1 example
info: Standalone read-only HTTP consumer. No MQTT and no dashboard add-on. Supply URL/token/device/channel through the Node-RED process environment. Configure and verify TLS trust. Start polling by setting the Poll inject repeat to 1 second. The watchdog clears old readings even if requests stall. Never wire the Prepare node directly to Debug.

name: Configure environment + TLS, then enable 1-second polling
info: RAYWN2_API_URL=https://station.example:47828; RAYWN2_API_TOKEN from your private secret store; RAYWN2_API_DEVICE exact identity; RAYWN2_API_CHANNEL 1-4. Set the TLS CA file/upload for a self-signed host; keep verification enabled. Import into its own tab. No deployed flows need replacing.
